## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 24, 2026 - Aug 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _y. Reddy_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "Editing to respond to the developer: When the 'free' experience is frustrating and ineffective, yes you should be sorry. This app is like using a calculator that makes you pay for the total after you hit 'enter'. You decided to put basic nutritional information behind a paywall because of greed and nothing else. Your free features are useless I forgot why I deleted this app years ago. Putting everything from protein onwards behind a paywall is a gross cash grab and you should be ashamed."
            2. _RJ_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "too many notifications about upgrading from a paid premium account to an even more expensive premium plus account. I can't disable those notifications that come up every other day. you guys are already collecting money from me, but you want more for an upgraded experience? I'll be requesting a refund and finding another app."
            3. _Richard Mead_, Aug 25, 2026, 1/5: "So much is behind a subscription based paywall that using the app for more than basic tracking is useless. Use a less restricted app instead of mfp"
<!--/ir-theme-->
